text:
PLAN REVIEW:

**Feasibility: PASS** — Every claim verified against source. All nine `max-w-6xl` containers exist (App.tsx lines 168, 198, 300, 335, 370, 414, 441, 544, 596); `py-20` sections, hero `pt-28`/`text-4xl md:text-5xl`, stat `p-5`, and project media `h-48 md:h-full object-cover` (line 455) all match the recorded baseline. The six-project array carries six distinct `images.unsplash.com` URLs for fallback. The CV anchor `href="/NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx"` exists (line 242) and the file exists at `public/NHEB_Tinarith_CV.docx`. `vite.config.ts:14` confirms `base` derives from the `FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL` ternary, so `import.meta.env.BASE_URL` concatenation (`BASE_URL + 'screenshots/<slug>.png'`) resolves correctly under both root and prefixed deployments (BASE_URL always ends with `/`). `public/screenshots/` and `docs/` are absent as expected — both tasks create them. Target values hit thresholds exactly: `max-w-7xl`=1280px, `py-24`=96px, `md:py-28`=112px, `h-56`=224px, `p-7`>`p-5`, `text-5xl md:text-6xl`>`text-4xl md:text-5xl` at both breakpoints. All six normative slugs match the FR-004 table character-for-character.

**Completeness: PASS** — Obligation traceability holds: FR-001/002/003/007→1.1, FR-004/005/008→1.2, FR-006→1.3; SC-001/002/007→1.1, SC-003/004/005/008→1.2, SC-006→1.3. Zero unmapped FRs, zero unmapped SCs (spec SCs are Given/When/Then form with no MUST/SHALL SC-### obligations; the MUST/SHALL language lives entirely in FRs, all of which map). Every task has concrete action, exact file targets, and falsifiable acceptance criteria. Task 1.3's checklist enumeration covers every element FR-006 demands (filenames, destination dir, per-project capture subjects, platform steps, ~5:3≈1600×960, <500KB budget, lowercase-.png case warning, center-crop note).

**Dependency ordering: PASS** — All `depends: []` is correct: no task consumes another's output. Tasks 1.1 and 1.2 share `src/App.tsx`, but the locked serial execution profile (`parallelization_enabled: false`, `max_concurrent_tasks: 1`, `locked: true` — internally consistent, not the contradictory parallel/max-1 case) eliminates write conflicts. Profile is internally coherent including `commit_after_each_completed_task: false` given there is no git repo.

**Scope containment: PASS** — No new runtime dependencies, single-page frontend only, governance files untouched, copy/data unchanged. One scope rider noted below (CV href fix).

**Risk assessment: PASS** — Changes are bounded class substitutions, one small React component, and one markdown doc. No migration, no cross-platform assumptions, no schema changes. Rollback note below re: absent VCS.

Reasoning: The plan is unusually concrete — exact class substitutions, normative filenames matching the spec table exactly, and deterministic Tailwind value mappings that make acceptance criteria verifiable by inspection plus `vite build`. Serial locked execution correctly neutralizes the only shared-file overlap. All findings are minor and none block approval.

VERDICT SUPPORT — seven dimensions: atomicity PASS (1.1/1.2 each touch two files but as one cohesive concern each — index.css is conditional token work, .gitkeep is trivially coupled; independently completable and QA-able); dependency correctness PASS; blast radius PASS (≤2 files/task); rollback safety minor concern (no git repo — see issue 3); testing strategy PASS-with-note (no test framework exists; build-exit-zero + code inspection + dev-server manual checks are the honest verification suite here, and acceptance criteria are written to be checkable that way); cross-platform PASS; migration PASS.

ISSUES:
1. MINOR — Task 1.1 describes the "from" state as `py-20` for all sections, but hero actually uses `pt-28 pb-24` and footer uses `py-6` (App.tsx lines 198, 595). The target state (`py-24 md:py-28` everywhere, footer included) still satisfies FR-001's ≥96px desktop requirement across all eight named regions. Suggested fix: implementer treats the listed target classes as normative and ignores the imprecise "from" values for hero/footer.
2. MINOR — Task 1.2's CV-anchor base-awareness fix maps to no FR number. It is justified (reality-check-008: root-absolute href breaks under prefixed FIGMA_PUBLIC_URL; aligns with FR-004's base-path principle; touches no copy/personal data), but should be flagged in task completion notes as a deliberate scope rider so phase review doesn't count it as drift.
3. MINOR — No git repo exists, so mid-phase failure recovery depends entirely on tooling snapshots. Suggested fix: save a checkpoint before task 1.1's first edit to enable clean revert of App.tsx/index.css.
4. MINOR — FR-005 fallback: the onError handler must swap src exactly once (local-fail → stock-fail would otherwise re-trigger error handling). Spec Assumptions accept an empty media box when the CDN is blocked, so a one-shot guarded swap satisfies the requirement. Worth stating in the coder prompt.
5. MINOR — Runtime acceptance criteria (360px no-scroll, per-card fallback independence, corrupt-file fallback) cannot be machine-verified without a browser/test framework; they will rest on inspection plus manual preview checks. Acceptable given environment constraints, but the verifying reviewer should record explicit inspection evidence per criterion.

SUMMARY: A precise, fully traceable, feasibility-verified plan whose only weaknesses are cosmetic baseline phrasing and environment-imposed verification limits — all minor, none blocking.

VERDICT: APPROVED
